body: Decision 0522 (branch claude/go-1-27-2-pin, head 8410da997) moves the repo Go pin to go1.27.2. The CEM stable verifier tuple (internal/cem/verify/stable.go:181, interop/cem01-go cem.go and stable_repository.go) and the sha256-pinned S0E FULL-RESULT-CASES.json packet stay at go1.27.1, because the packet is evidence. On a go1.27.2 build, the S0E outcome checks, the interop TestStableCanonical* checks (88 subtests) and the native linked control report NOT_RUN, and `cem verify` of a cem/1.0 map refuses with unsupported-structural-runtime. CEM 1.0 in RC3 (decision 0521) needs a qualified stable path on the pinned toolchain.

Tests: internal/cem/... and interop/cem01-go go test/go vet PASS on go1.27.2. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference). Evidence: sha256 of the go1.27.2 toolchain and V1-0632 S1 build-log records at the merge commit.
